NO y measurements in the free troposphere are a powerful tool to study the atmospheric NO x lifetime and its chemical transformation processes, but the long-term analysis is challenging due to the high variability in NO x concentrations, the low NO x /NO y ratios and the high variability in the chemical transformation of NO x to NO y species.
NO y measurements at JFJ can be considered as reliable and representative for the lower free tropospheric air masses in Europe and the North-Atlantic.

the NO y data set at JFJ is reliable and of high quality.
NO y is a more reliable indicator of NO x emissions than the NO x itself, which is subject to rapid conversion to NO z.
